trades.title: Completed purchases under long-term retention plan
trades.summary: (Trondheim, 4 August 2026) OKEA ASA (OSE: OKEA) completed share purchases 3 August, in connection with the long-term retention plan (LTRP). The share purchases on behalf of leading employees were made in accordance with the company's LTRP. The shares are subject to a 24-month lock-up period.

His updated shareholding after the transaction is 30,450 shares. This information is subject to disclosure obligations pursuant to the EU Market Regulation, cf.
